[PFIZER INC (PFE) | 10-K | FY2023 | Item 1A: RISK FACTORS]
Our manufacturing facility in Rocky Mount, NC was damaged by a tornado in July 2023. While manufacturing has resumed, the supply of medicines impacted by the tornado is expected to be affected through 2024. See the Overview of Our Performance, Operating Environment, Strategy and Outlook—Our Operating Environment section within MD&A.
COLLABORATIONS AND OTHER RELATIONSHIPS WITH THIRD PARTIES
